mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which often precedes a downturn in economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS shows a sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side activity, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases by > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases by > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 200k and UNRATE decreases by > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by > 200k and UNRATE decreases by > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by > 10% and RSAFS decreases by > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST decreases by > 10% and RSAFS decreases by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a strengthening supply-side with easing monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by > 1% and FEDFUNDS decreases by > 0.25% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by > 1% and FEDFUNDS decreases by > 0.25%.
